raw_html: [[Legendary Stone Guard|Legendary Stone Guard]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Legendary Stone Guard]]:''' This item is invested with the power of the earth. On being struck in melee, it has the chance to attempt to turn the target to stone, as the [[Flesh to Stone]] spell. A successful [[Fortitude save]] (DC 100) negates the effect.
